caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a male figure standing on a dark rectangular pedestal. The figure is dressed in a bright red, long-sleeved tunic adorned with gold details and a black sash tied at the waist. The tunic has puffy sleeves and a black trim at the neckline. The figure's legs appear to be covered in brown leggings and brown shoes. The figure's right arm is extended forward, palm facing up and holding what appears to be a bundle or object, while the left hand is placed on the waist. The figure's facial features are distinct, with a brown complexion and serious expression. On the head, the figure wears a red band with three large feathers—two green and one red—protruding upward. The background is plain, with a beige color. The artwork includes a signature near the bottom left corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
